title: Positive: keyboard operation, motion preferences and page structure basics are sound
expected: Logical focus order, visible focus, operable controls, motion preferences honoured.
actual: Tab order on login, register and landing follows the visual order with a visible focus indicator at every stop; the visually hidden terms checkbox toggles with Space; tour and checkout dialogs use dialog roles with focus management; infinite animations stop under prefers-reduced-motion; every page sets lang="en" and a title; layout shift is low (CLS ≤ 0.051); Lighthouse best-practices 96–100 and SEO 91–100; the checkout form has labels and autocomplete on every field.
